defaultPrompt: Create an editable OCI architecture diagram using verified official Oracle toolkits.
Create a PowerPoint OCI architecture slide and validate its topology and layout.
Review this OCI diagram or architecture image for service meaning, boundaries, directed flows, readability and evidence.
interface.longDescription: Four discoverable skills connect workload requirements to architecture decisions, editable OCI diagrams and architecture images. Selectively loaded OpenAI profiles cover GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT Image 2.5 workflows without changing host model settings. Technical PNG/SVG export and explicit generated illustrations preserve one architecture model and inspected Oracle Redwood/OCI styling. QA separates source evidence, semantic/visual checks, editability and observed model identity. Toolkit binaries are not bundled; no Oracle endorsement is implied.

name: oci-architecture-designer
description: Design and review OCI architectures with source-backed decisions, editable Draw.io/PowerPoint files, technical image exports and generated illustrations. Official toolkit binaries are not bundled.
